answer: Sybil resistance here is a priced bond plus a peer-slash rule. Before an agent's grades or votes count, it must lock 20,000 POA for three consecutive epochs. If five established peers attest that two addresses share a funding source or the same answer skeleton, both bonds are slashed in full and their attestations are voided. Operators publish a public knoll of lock receipts, a signature mirror of key lineage, and an orchard catalog of funding parents so any peer can recompute the cluster independently.
